### Props

| Name                | Type                                                                                                 | Required | Default                                      | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `appName`           | `string`                                                                                             | ✓        | —                                            | Display name of the host app, interpolated into the body copy (e.g. "Decidiq", "OpenRegister"). Required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `appSlug`           | `string`                                                                                             | ✓        | —                                            | Kebab-case app id used as the localStorage namespace by `useSupportDialog`. Required so two apps mounted in the same Nextcloud session don't share a "shown" flag.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `appStoreUrl`       | `string`                                                                                             | ✓        | —                                            | Nextcloud App Store listing URL for the host app — opens in a new tab when the "Review on App Store" CTA fires. Required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `featureRequestUrl` | `string`                                                                                             | ✓        | —                                            | URL the "Suggest a feature" CTA opens (typically the host app's forge "new issue" form, e.g. on Codeberg). Required.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `donateUrl`         | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'https://github.com/sponsors/ConductionNL'` | URL the "Donate" CTA opens. Defaults to ConductionNL's GitHub Sponsors page so apps that haven't set up their own donation channel still have a working button.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `supportUrl`        | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'https://www.conduction.nl/support'`        | URL the "Get support" CTA opens. Defaults to the Conduction support page, where organisations are matched with a Host, Service, or Certified partner. Conduction does not sell direct support — the apps stay free and support runs through partners.                                                                                                                           |
| `conductionUrl`     | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'https://www.conduction.nl'`                | Target of the inline "Conduction" link in the default body copy. Ignored when `bodyParagraphs` is provided.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `appsUrl`           | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'https://www.conduction.nl/connext'`        | Target of the inline "apps" link in the default body copy. Ignored when `bodyParagraphs` is provided.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `founderName`       | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'Ruben van der Linde'`                      | Name rendered in the handwritten signature line. Defaults to Ruben van der Linde; overridable so a Conduction-adjacent consumer can sign their own apps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `founderTitle`      | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'a founder of Conduction'`                  | Title shown under the signature name. Defaults to "a founder of Conduction" (Conduction has more than one founder); override when signing your own apps.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `founderAvatarUrl`  | `string`                                                                                             |          | `DEFAULT_FOUNDER_AVATAR`                     | Avatar shown to the left of the signature. Defaults to the bundled founder portrait (data URI, self-hosted — no third-party request). Override with any URL or data URI when signing your own apps.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `founderProfileUrl` | `string`                                                                                             |          | `'https://www.linkedin.com/in/rubenlinde/'`  | Profile the avatar links to (opens in a new tab). Defaults to the founder's LinkedIn. Pass an empty string to render the avatar without a link.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `bodyParagraphs`    | `array`                                                                                              |          | `[]`                                         | Optional body-copy override. When non-empty, the array is rendered verbatim — one `&lt;p&gt;` per entry, no inline links — and the built-in Conduction copy is skipped. Useful for one-off campaigns (release announcement, new pricing) where the founder note is not the right voice.                                                                                         |
| `title`             | `string`                                                                                             |          | `''`                                         | Optional dialog-title override. When empty the title is the default "Support \{appName\}". Set it to title the note however you like.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `buttons`           | `{[id: string]: {enabled?: boolean, label?: string, url?: string, variant?: string, icon?: string}}` |          | `\{\}`                                       | Per-button overrides, keyed by button id (`donate`, `support`, `feature-request`, `app-store`). Each value may set `enabled` (false hides the button), `label`, `url`, `variant` (`primary`/`secondary`/`tertiary`) and `icon` (a PascalCase MDI name). Unset fields fall back to the built-in defaults, so callers override only what they want and can drop buttons entirely. |

### Events

| Name     | Payload | Description                                                                                                                                                             |
| -------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `close`  | —       | Emitted when the user dismisses the dialog (backdrop click, ESC, close icon). Pair with `useSupportDialog().hide` to also persist the dismissal.                        |
| `action` | —       | Fired alongside the native `window.open` call on each CTA click. Useful for analytics or to short-circuit the default open-in-new-tab behaviour from a parent listener. |
